scout.name: scout
scout.description: Read-only repository scout for bounded engineering discovery. Use to locate relevant code, tests, conventions, interfaces, and constraints before specification or implementation.

worker.name: worker
worker.description: Implementation agent for one bounded, low-decision task with explicit requirements, known files, a test-first instruction, and objective completion criteria.
worker.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, Bash

reviewer.name: reviewer
reviewer.description: Independent read-only reviewer that checks an implementation diff against explicit requirements, acceptance scenarios, the implementation plan, tests, and repository conventions.
